people.name: Canaan
people.line: Son of Ham; father of Sidon and Heth

people.name: Ham
people.line: One of Noah's three sons, father of Canaan.

translations.web: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.
translations.bsb: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father’s nakedness and told his two brothers outside.
